about.en: 我踏马来了 ("Wo Ta Ma Lai Le", a Chinese slang pun on "here I come" for the Year of the Horse) is a community-run, Chinese-language meme token on BNB Chain, launched through Four.meme at the turn of 2026. It is the BEP-20 token at 0xc51A9250795c0186a6FB4A7D20A90330651e4444 and has no project or utility beyond its community.
